text:
is the ave in the aire with sosiego,

in the water the pez, the salamandra in fire,

and the man, in cuyo to be all itself encierra,

is in the sola earth.

I alone, that nací for tormentos,

the boca I have in aire suspirando,

the body in earth is peregrinando,

the eyes I have in water night and day,

and in fire the heart and the soul mía.

translation.title: lover without reposo
